clips.title: The story
paras: At Duskwood’s northern edge, Darkened Bank follows the river beside Elwynn Forest. Its shore runs east toward the Redridge Mountains, between the safer north and the forest’s terrors.

Darkened Bank follows the river that separates Duskwood from Elwynn Forest. The shore runs from western river bends east toward the stone span leading to the Redridge Mountains. Under Duskwood’s gloomy canopy, it is often the first ground travelers reach when coming south from Elwynn. Near its western tip, a makeshift camp shelters displaced refugees Sven Yorgen and Lars, just beyond the deep woods.
